description: The full automated test coverage for all new backends (design section 10) plus the regression gate. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 being implemented, so it comes last. Adds Business Profile, Settings, Dashboard (stats/fees/renewal), and Help feature tests, extends ManualPaymentTest for the Treasurer flash, and confirms the 154/519 baseline plus the new tests are all green. Uses the existing Tests\Support\MakesDomainData trait and RefreshDatabase.
steps: Create tests/Feature/Applicant/BusinessProfileTest.php (use MakesDomainData, RefreshDatabase): first PUT /business-profile creates a businesses row with user_id = the authed applicant; second PUT updates the SAME row (one row, values changed — confirms one-per-user by editing oldest); PUT with an extra 'role' field in the payload leaves the user's role as 'applicant' (role not mass-assignable); creating a new application (POST /applications) links business_id and upserts a Business when none existed, while an existing business_id-null flow still submits.

Create tests/Feature/Applicant/SettingsTest.php: profile update (PUT /settings/profile) changes name/contact_number/address/email with role unchanged; email uniqueness rejects another user's email; password change (PUT /settings/password) with the CORRECT current password succeeds and the new password authenticates; password change with a WRONG current password is rejected (assert validation error on current_password AND the password is unchanged); a profile save preserving an existing max:32-style contact_number (e.g. a landline the strict ApplicationRequest regex would reject) succeeds; change-password policy parity — a password accepted at registration is accepted here and one rejected at registration is rejected here.

Create tests/Feature/Applicant/DashboardTest.php: build applications in known statuses via makeApplication and assert the four stat counts (pending=SUBMITTED+UNDER_REVIEW, approved=PERMIT_RELEASED, action=FOR_CORRECTION+APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT); the Action-needed callout shows the CORRECTION remark body; fee amount NOT shown for UNDER_REVIEW (assertDontSee); fee/'Assessment ready' reachable at APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT; a REJECTED application shows NO fee and NO permit block (assertDontSee the peso amount and 'Assessment ready'); a FOR_CORRECTION application shows NO fee block; re-payment routing — an APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT application with a STATUS_FAILED Payment row (with rejection_reason) links the fee summary to applications.pay (NOT applications.payments) and surfaces the rejection reason; current-payment selection — a PAYMENT_PENDING/PAYMENT_VERIFIED application with an older FAILED row plus a newer active row shows the newer row's amount/chip; a PAYMENT_PENDING application shows the 'Treasurer is verifying' callout and is not counted in any of the four stat cards; a PAYMENT_VERIFIED application shows the 'permit being prepared' callout; the stat partition total === pending+action+approved+paymentPending+paymentVerified+draft+rejected holds across a nine-status fixture; Renewal Reminder — a makePermit(...,$validUntil) inside the window shows the banner and one far in the future does NOT.

Create tests/Feature/Applicant/HelpPageTest.php (light): GET /help renders for an applicant and the GCash number from config is present; a guest is redirected to login and a non-applicant role is blocked by the role:applicant middleware.
Extend tests/Feature/Payment/ManualPaymentTest.php: after a manual GCash start() submission, assert the redirect/session flash contains 'Treasurer' and does NOT contain 'BPLO'.
Run the full regression gate and the targeted regression-sensitive files; clean up any temporary artifacts created during verification.
acceptance_criteria: All new test files pass: BusinessProfileTest, SettingsTest, DashboardTest, HelpPageTest, and the extended ManualPaymentTest assertion.
The wrong-current-password case is explicitly asserted to reject and leave the password unchanged.
The REJECTED-no-fee and FOR_CORRECTION-no-fee branches and the re-payment routing to applications.pay are explicitly asserted.
The renewal near-expiry-shows / far-future-does-not pair is explicitly asserted.
php artisan test is GREEN with at least the prior 154 passed / 519 assertions still passing plus the new tests.

php artisan test — full suite GREEN (>= 154 + new tests).
findings:
Implemented all five test deliverables and they pass. Final full suite: 182 passed / 630 assertions (baseline was 154/519; +28 new tests, well above the >154 gate). Regression-sensitive files (ApplicationFlowTest, Authorization\MassAssignmentTest, Payment\ManualPaymentTest) all green.

Files added: tests/Feature/Applicant/BusinessProfileTest.php, SettingsTest.php, DashboardTest.php, HelpPageTest.php. Extended tests/Feature/Payment/ManualPaymentTest.php with test_manual_start_flash_names_the_treasurer_not_the_bplo (flash contains 'Treasurer', not 'BPLO').

PRE-EXISTING BUG FOUND AND FIXED in resources/views/applicant/dashboard.blade.php (a FEAT-002 deliverable). The new DashboardTest exercised the control-center view with real applications for the first time and exposed that the view silently truncated: every section after the welcome banner (renewal banner, callouts, stat cards, per-application detail cards) was dropped and some paths 500'd with 'Undefined variable $application'. Root cause: the Blade @php(...) single-line shortcut mis-compiles when the expression contains nested parentheses (e.g. @php($correction = $application->remarks->where('type','CORRECTION')->sortByDesc('created_at')->first())) and when two @php(...) shortcuts sit on consecutive lines (the renewal block). The shortcut emitted a malformed '<?php(...' with no closing tag, leaving the remainder of the template as raw/uncompiled Blade. Fix was behavior-restoring only (no design change): converted the two affected @php(...) shortcuts to full @php ... @endphp blocks. After the fix the dashboard renders exactly as cc-design.md section 2 specifies. Verified with php artisan view:clear + a render dump, then removed the temporary debug test.

Test-authoring note: Payment.rejection_reason is a real DB column but is NOT in Payment::$fillable, so it cannot be mass-assigned via Payment::create(); the test now sets it by direct property assignment + save() (mirroring the Treasurer reject flow). Verification used php artisan test with cwd 'c:\\Users\\HP\\BUSINESS PERMIT_SYSTEM\\app'. Temporary artifacts (tmp debug test, HTML dump) were cleaned up.
